_comment: 2+2 EC-CHECK configuration with shared parity buffer model
_description: All columns share the same parity buffer. Column 0 initializes parity, Column 1+ incrementally update parity.

columns._comment: Column 0: First encoder - Initializes shared parity buffer with encoding XOR zero_parity
columns._note: send_peer and recv_peer set to -1 for auto-calculation based on current rank

columns._comment: Column 1: Second encoder - Incrementally updates shared parity buffer with parity XOR recv_encoding
columns._note: In incremental mode: parity = parity XOR recv_encoding

_implementation_notes.column_0_behavior: Initializes parity: parity = encoding0 XOR zero_parity
_implementation_notes.column_1_behavior: Incremental update: parity = parity XOR recv_encoding1
_implementation_notes.thread_safety: Uses mutex to protect shared parity buffer during incremental updates
